title: Emblem Project Utrecht
notes: Dutch love emblem books of the seventeenth century (about 27 books, c. 1601 to 1724, secular and religious, by Heinsius, Vaenius, Hooft, Cats, Hugo, Luyken and others). Each book has full transcriptions, page facsimiles, indexes and concordances, an editorial introduction and Iconclass-based search and comparison tools, stored in an XML (TEI) database. The Emblem Project Utrecht was a joint effort of Utrecht University (Faculty of Arts, OGC, University Library), the Koninklijke Bibliotheek, DBNL and the Emblem Digitization Project; NWO funded it from November 2003 to November 2006 (project coordination E. Stronks). Texts are viewed as HTML on the site; no bulk download is offered, and the site continues to be online. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
